BiblicalUsage: tsᵉchôq describes laughter (in pleasure or derision). It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Genesis 21:6 and Ezekiel 23:32.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsᵉchôq belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
